description: This is a JUnit test class for the BookRepository component of a book tracking application. It contains test cases for CRUD operations and query methods related to the Book entity, ensuring repository correctness within a Spring Data JPA context.

classes.name: BookRepositoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing BookRepository CRUD and query methods in a Spring Data JPA environment.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up test data before each test, including creating a user, an author, a predefined shelf, and a book.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteABook_whenAuthorHasOtherBooks
methods.description: Tests successful deletion of a book when the author has other books in the repository.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteSingleAuthoredBook
methods.description: Tests deletion of a book when it's the only book by the author.

methods.name: canFindBookByTitle
methods.description: Verifies search functionality for books by title with case-insensitive containment.

methods.name: allBooksFoundWhenNoFilterPassed
methods.description: Disabled test to verify that all books are retrieved when no filter is applied.

methods.name: canFindBookByTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Disabled test to verify search functionality by title or author.

methods.name: canFindBookByAuthor
methods.description: Disabled test to verify search functionality by author name.

methods.name: canGetAllBooksForUser
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of all books associated with a specific user.
